original_text: I want to describe myself on my own page in a semi-structured way, so that others can learn about me.
final_text:
User Story:
As an individual, I want to develop a well-organized yet adaptable profile overview on my personal site so that visitors can quickly grasp my background and interests.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Include key sections such as a personal biography, a list of skills, and a description of hobbies.
- Create a visually appealing and user-friendly layout for optimal engagement.
- Allow for easy content updates to keep the information current and relevant.

Test Outline:
- Review the webpage to ensure all key sections are present and logically structured.
- Assess the visual design for effectiveness and user navigation ease.
- Verify the functionality of the content update feature to ensure modifications can be made smoothly.

original_text: I want to fill out an application to become a Certified Scrum Practitioner, so that I can earn that designation.
final_text:
User Story:
As an aspiring Scrum professional, I aim to finalize my application for the Certified Scrum Practitioner credential to enhance my career opportunities and professional growth.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Successfully complete and submit the application form with all necessary details
- Receive a confirmation notification indicating successful application submission
- Attain the certification after fulfilling all required criteria

Test Outline:
- Confirm that the application form can be accurately filled out and submitted without any errors
- Check for a confirmation email or notification following the submission
- Verify that the certification is granted upon meeting all specified requirements

original_text: As a Practitioner, I want to include additional details about me in my profile page, so that I can showcase my experience.
final_text:
User Story:
As a Practitioner, I want to enrich my profile page with more comprehensive information about my background, so that I can effectively highlight my expertise and experience to potential clients or employers.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Provide fields for adding certifications, skills, and work history.
- Ensure that the profile updates are saved and displayed correctly.
- Allow users to preview changes before finalizing their profile updates.

Test Outline:
- Verify that all new fields for additional details are functional and user-friendly.
- Check that updates are accurately reflected on the profile after saving.
- Test the preview feature to ensure it displays the profile accurately before submission.

original_text: As a site member, I want to fill out an application to become a Certified Scrum Trainer, so that I can teach CSM and CSPO courses and certify others.
final_text:
User Story:
As a site member, I want to complete my application for Scrum Trainer certification so that I can effectively teach Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) and Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) courses, thereby enabling the certification of future professionals in the Scrum domain.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Successfully fill out and submit the application for Scrum Trainer certification.
- Receive a confirmation message indicating that the application has been successfully submitted.
- Obtain timely updates regarding the status of my application within a specified period.

Test Outline:
- Verify that the application form is intuitive and allows for seamless submission.
- Ensure that an acknowledgment email is received confirming the application submission.
- Monitor the response time for updates on the application status to ensure it meets the established timeframe.

original_text: As a Trainer, I want to include additional details in my profile page about me, so that others can learn about me and decide if I am the right trainer for them.
final_text:
User Story:
As a Trainer, I want to enrich my profile page with detailed personal information so that potential clients can better understand my qualifications and assess whether I meet their training needs.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Create distinct sections highlighting my certifications, work history, and training philosophy.
- Include a personal statement that conveys my distinctive training approach and techniques.
- Design the profile to be visually appealing and intuitive for seamless navigation.

Test Outline:
- Review the profile page to confirm the inclusion of the new sections.
- Assess the clarity and impact of the personal statement.
- Analyze the overall design and user-friendliness of the profile layout.
